lines.say: Tier F, doing nothing. Clients drift away, and you never even notice.
Tier C, asking at the chair. It only reaches whoever is sitting in front of you.
Tier B, texting them yourself. It works, until you have hundreds of clients and somebody slips through.
Also tier B, Vah-rah-go. A booking tool first, and text marketing is a paid add-on.
Tier A, Book-see. Solid reactivation messages, with two thousand marketing texts included.
Gloss Genius. Automated rebooking reminder texts on the Gold plan.
Squire. Smart Rebooking learns client habits, and it runs win-back campaigns.
Tier S, Message Health. A texting and retention platform that scores every client against their own rhythm.
Not a fixed rule like ninety days. It shows you exactly why a client is at risk.
Then it texts the quiet ones back for you, and every reply lands in one shared inbox.
Reminders, review requests, bookings, payments, and analytics, all in one place.
And you can tie Message Health into your favorite tool with your API keys.
Plans start at fifty dollars a month, and your first month is half off.
If you wanna see why we are better, comment RETAIN, and I will DM you. Not an automated one.
